intent.raw: Use Invoke to turn accepted contract-completeness audit 002 into one complete DomainSpec v2 all-backend definition, architecture, implementation plan, and work-pack.
intent.objective: Rebase the existing BTE implementation package through active Invoke define, design, and plan modes; preserve EVF as evidence; resolve authority blockers before Task Session execution.
intent.operator_sentence: Author one complete implementation-facing package inside projects/domainspec-v2; do not create a competing CyberAlchemy owner, do not use Markdown as semantic source, and do not execute implementation in Invoke.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Final package review crosses definition, architecture, executable-plan, evidence, and consumer-boundary claims.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Independent reviewers should attack authority inflation, vacuous completeness, and SWU executability after the authored package exists; they are not needed to write this proposal.
context: Audit 002 required two verifier rounds to repair selector, authority-label, and denominator defects.
The future package must reconcile 13 kinds, 16 criteria, 16 candidate relationship families, graph causality, and downstream consumers without collapsing owners.

roles.purpose: Check machine-source authority, definitions, requirements, and six-view design closure.
Check tasks, SWUs, algorithms, dependencies, validation, and first-unit narrowness.
Check gap parity, consumer boundaries, receipts, and non-promotion claims.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: After Define, Design, and Plan artifacts exist, may three read-only reviewers independently audit the complete BTE package?

steps.name: Select audit evidence and existing target artifacts
stop_conditions: accepted audit evidence is missing or drifted
target implementation root is ambiguous

steps.name: Author the all-backend definition and requirement baseline

inputs.ref: explicit apply approval for this proposal

stop_conditions: Markdown is described as semantic authority
13 kinds, 16 criteria, and 16 relationship families are conflated
source owner is unresolved but hidden

steps.name: Resolve current-v1 formation authority
stop_conditions: no human-owned selection between dual enforcement and versioned replacement
current-v1 compatibility is silently broken

steps.name: Author the six-view architecture and source contracts
stop_conditions: any of six required views is missing
generated graph or receipt is promoted to source authority
consumer proof can self-validate

steps.name: Resolve relationship and key-and-door scope decisions
stop_conditions: candidate relationship families are called admitted
DEC-GCP-001 is made a global backend blocker

steps.name: Regenerate the implementation layering, plan, tasks, SWUs, waves, and validation strategy
stop_conditions: completed SWU receipts are renumbered or invalidated
a task lacks algorithm, edge cases, write scope, or validation
more than one first SWU is selected

steps.name: Validate SWU atomicity, first-unit narrowness, and recomposition
stop_conditions: Distill verdict is not pass
first unit mixes authority decision, compiler change, corpus breadth, and receipt integration

steps.name: Independently audit the complete authored package
stop_conditions: user has not authorized the review dispatch
review finds authority inflation, missing denominator cells, or non-executable SWUs

steps.name: Expose exactly one dependency-ready SWU to Task Session
stop_conditions: review verdict is not ACCEPT
no SWU is dependency-ready
more than one SWU is selected
Invoke would execute implementation

gates.condition: The user explicitly approves applying this proposal and running active Invoke define, design, and plan modes.
Deferred full mode is not executed; only active modes run with independent gates.
GAP-029 has one explicit versioned decision and a current-v1 compatibility rule before design/implementation claims proceed.
13 kinds and 16 criteria remain canonical schema inventory; 16 relationship families remain selected planning coverage until separately admitted.
YAML, JSON, code, decisions, and receipts own machine claims; Markdown explains and plans only.
The high-complexity split work-pack has L0-L3 waves, implementation-detail task specs, atomic SWUs, a pass Distill verdict, and one narrow first unit.
IOLM and Body War return fresh independent receipts and cannot supply DomainSpec semantic authority.
The final authored package is accepted with source hashes, denominator parity, and no authority inflation.
Invoke stops before source mutation; Task Session selects and executes exactly one reviewed SWU.

observability.signal_grouping: Group Invoke authoring, decisions, validation, review, and future handoff by dispatch and step IDs; preserve target-artifact ownership separately.

boundaries.contract: Audit findings constrain authored claims but do not become semantic authority.
Reuse graph/object/receipt design by handle; do not retain a second executable work-pack owner.
Formation authority and relationship admission are human-owned decisions; DEC-GCP-001 gates only its semantic fixture scope.
Only one reviewed SWU handle crosses; Invoke performs no implementation mutation.
Consumers return fresh receipts after core; their fixtures, Markdown, and self-asserted handles cannot replace DomainSpec sources or independent replay.

authority.execution: Task Session, one reviewed SWU at a time
authority.validation: machine validators, Distill, then separately authorized independent review
authority.memory: Inventory is a generated lookup projection only
authority.promotion: DomainSpec profile, relationship, and release owners only

state_namespaces.write_policy: Only a later approved SWU may mutate; Invoke references exact paths.
Invoke-authored definition, design, plan, work-pack, review, and session evidence.
Retained as evidence and optional narrow proof; no competing all-backend execution authority.
Independent consumer contracts and receipts only; no DomainSpec authority writes from this dispatch.

promotion_splits.rule: Evidence may constrain proposals but cannot promote definitions, profiles, relationships, or release state.
Execution proof remains non-admitting until the lifecycle owner explicitly promotes it.

promotion_guardrails: Audit acceptance is not DomainSpec completeness.
13 kinds and 16 criteria do not admit 16 relationship families.
Consumer receipts cannot self-author core truth.
Invoke authoring cannot execute SWUs or admit release state.
